title: ui-quality: flag a calendar or other trailing icon that sits misaligned inside a date or text input
notes: Observed 2026-11-25 on InteliFactu Nueva factura (/app?view=sales&screen=new-invoice, 1440 px light): the native date inputs Fecha de emision and Vencimiento show their calendar icon off the input's vertical centre and padding grid; the owner spotted it, codeality-ui check reported nothing.

Smallest next step: a rule that, for every input with a trailing icon (::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator or an absolutely positioned svg sibling), compares the icon box centre with the input content box centre and its right inset with the input's left padding; warn above 2 px. Add a fixture page reproducing the InteliFactu date input.
done_when: codeality-ui check flags the InteliFactu date input fixture and passes a correctly centred one
